Formal complaint – repeated prescriptions without investigation despite ongoing symptoms
Dear Practice Manager,
I am writing to raise a formal complaint regarding the care my wife has received at Woodside Medical Group. I am submitting this complaint with her full knowledge and consent.
For over a year, my wife has been experiencing persistent leg pain with visibly protruding veins, as well as ongoing head pain. These symptoms have significantly affected her daily life, wellbeing, and ability to function normally.
My wife has attended multiple GP appointments at this practice over an extended period seeking help for these symptoms. Despite repeated consultations, no definitive diagnosis has been made and no appropriate diagnostic investigations have been arranged.
Instead, medications have been repeatedly prescribed without any investigation into the underlying cause of her symptoms and without clear explanation of what condition is being treated. At her most recent appointment on 19 December 2025, medication was once again prescribed without any diagnostic tests, imaging, or referral being arranged.
During previous consultations, my wife was advised that further investigation might be considered in approximately one year, despite her symptoms already having persisted for over a year. We are extremely concerned that this represents an ongoing delay in investigation rather than appropriate clinical management.
At multiple appointments, her symptoms have been dismissed with reassurance that “there is nothing wrong,” despite visible venous changes and ongoing pain. This has left her distressed, unsupported, and without a clear management plan.
We believe this pattern of care raises serious concerns regarding patient safety, delayed diagnosis, and the appropriateness of continuing to prescribe medication without understanding the cause of her symptoms.
We respectfully request:
A full review of my wife’s care at Woodside Medical Group
Appropriate diagnostic investigations to identify the cause of her symptoms
Consideration of referral to relevant specialists (for example, vascular and/or neurological assessment)
Clear communication regarding diagnosis, treatment rationale, and next steps
My wife is not seeking emergency treatment. She is seeking responsible, evidence-based assessment and to have her long-standing symptoms properly investigated.
Thank you for your attention to this matter. We look forward to your response.
Yours sincerely",null,[0,93]]]],[null,1768222804000000,1768222804000000,"2 months ago",null,"https://business.google.com/local/business/15290810051793052605/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMnN4VDJWVmVFMVJiR1JSWkZoV2FsUlliRmRTUm1oV1lqSjBZV0pzUlJBQhAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/15290810051793052605/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMnN4VDJWVmVFMVJiR1JSWkZoV2FsUlliRmRTUm1oV1lqSjBZV0pzUlJBQhAA"],"https://business.google.com/local/business/15290810051793052605/customers/reviews/deletereply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMnN4VDJWVmVFMVJiR1JSWkZoV2FsUlliRmRTUm1oV1lqSjBZV0pzUlJBQhAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/15290810051793052605/customers/reviews/deletereply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMnN4VDJWVmVFMVJiR1JSWkZoV2FsUlliRmRTUm1oV1lqSjBZV0pzUlJBQhAA"],null,"https://business.google.com/local/business/15290810051793052605/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMnN4VDJWVmVFMVJiR1JSWkZoV2FsUlliRmRTUm1oV1lqSjBZV0pzUlJBQhAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/15290810051793052605/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMnN4VDJWVmVFMVJiR1JSWkZoV2FsUlliRmRTUm1oV1lqSjBZV0pzUlJBQhAA"],null,["en"],[["Please contact the practice either by phone or via the website for the attention of the Practice Manager, Shona Alexander, who will be happy to investigate your complaint.
